sources.title: MiniMax H3 AI Video Generator — 2K Video With Sound
sources.snippet: MiniMax H3 AI Video Generator Turn text, images, or reference clips into 2K video with sound already in it. Most AI video tools hand you a silent clip and leave the audio to you. MiniMax H3 writes the picture and the sound in the same pass — dialogue, room tone, music, and footsteps land already synced to the frame.

sources.title: MiniMax H3 AI Video Generator | H3 Video Studio
sources.snippet: Create 2K videos with MiniMax H3 using text, images, video, and audio references. Generate cinematic clips with native stereo sound in 4-15 seconds.

sources.title: MiniMax H3 (Hailuo 3) on Runway | AI Video up to 2K
sources.snippet: MiniMax H3 on Runway: multimodal AI video from text, image, video and audio references. Clips of 5 to 15 seconds at 768p or 2K, plus keyframe control.
